purpose: Offer calm, practical canine massage therapy and rehabilitation support for dogs and their owners.
targetAudience: Dog owners near Spilsby and Louth
Owners of companion, working and sporting dogs
Veterinary professionals who need clear therapy communication

confirmedProductFacts: Wolds Canine Massage Therapy is owned and run by Olivia Whitfield-Heap.
Appointments are normally available at the clinic room near Spilsby, with appointments also announced at James Street Veterinary Centre in Louth.
The service offers initial appointments and consultations, maintenance massage and puppy massage.
The service works with companion dogs and dogs involved in activities such as agility and flyball.
Owners should consult their veterinary surgeon before seeking massage treatment, and the therapist can communicate with veterinary teams.
The business offers a free introductory canine face massage course through Wolds Canine Therapy Academy.
